title: Exclude dyadic Borel savings in a common integral polynomial algebra (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic obstruction with exact finite corroboration. Dyadic full-Borel superposition words with every applied block in R[T], R = Z_(2), cannot save paid rank when T has 2-integral characteristic polynomial and the transformed data targets satisfy the cited unit contract. For n_I targets the floor is mW, at every width and register count.

```text
χ_T in R[x]
  -> finite lattice R^m + TR^m + ... + T^(m-1)R^m
  -> one common paired integral representation
  -> cited PR2613 rank floor: sum_paid rank(A) >= mW
```

If T occurs as an actual applied block, this is also a necessary criterion for a common paired lattice. An explicit width-three family at every denominator 2^s has no coordinate-diagonal gauge and no complete rational rank-one projector family in its block algebra. It has noncommuting address labels, paid ranks one and two, and a sharp abstract endpoint of paid rank 3W.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Sagar Thakrar's PR2613 supplies the dyadic-register question and the cited rank theorem; eumemic and Swapnil Jain retain the register/lattice and rank-functional credit. The theorem is used as a premise, not audited or replayed. ywz65's PR2671 and the older PR6027 supply distinct diagonal and complete-anchor filters. Cayley-Hamilton and the invariant-module ingredients are classical; no global literature priority is claimed for them. The new result is the precise monogenic source-model obstruction, separating family and bounded certificate implementation.

## Evidence

Before, the named filters require a coordinate-diagonal gauge or a complete rank-one anchor family. The new explicit family meets neither premise. After, the written proof constructs its common lattice and transfers the existing mW floor without either premise.

On CPython 3.12.15, Darwin arm64, standard library only:

- Warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass. Each checks all 625 half-integral two-by-two matrices, four additional matrices, eight complete formal words, twelve rejection controls and five scope controls. The independent checker uses determinant expansion rather than the constructor's trace recurrence. Normal and optimized timings were 0.117 and 0.109 seconds, below each 120-second timeout; these are replay-budget measurements.
- The complete registered replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`; both direct modes print `PASS_MONOGENIC_BOREL_LATTICE`. Receipts are generated from all seven package hashes.
- Metadata and pins, in-memory compilation, AST/function-length inspection and staged whitespace pass. Committed-byte/source-history preflight authenticates all seven files at `e3c2dc5ab61b3baafa5ca3ea2c6b96c71d8b3120` and the pinned main ancestor.
- Official export and declared-input coverage pass. Both direct modes pass from a read-only Git-free export with an empty executable PATH. All eight exported files, including the export manifest, preserve their bytes and modes.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/monogenic-borel-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/monogenic-borel-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/monogenic-borel-lattice
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/monogenic-borel-lattice --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable may replace that local path. The quantified claim rests on PROOF.md and the cited rank theorem, not finite extrapolation. Base main is `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, unchanged at the submission refresh. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19440637).

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The caller must supply the complete applied block list, including every inverse, its R[T] representations and the actual target-unit condition. Rational polynomial coefficients alone are insufficient. Failure of this test does not prove a saving. The basis change is analytic and supplies no free physical gate. The implementation supports exact matrices of dimensions one through four; the proof has no dimension cap.

No physical native supplier, complete cost/precision/stock/tape invoice, compiler or outer admission is supplied. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected scientific replay, predecessor executable, Lean or Docker ran. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Every registered command ran locally; none is deferred solely to CI. No κ or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Open next questions

- Apply the criterion to one concrete candidate with a complete applied list and independently supplied endpoint/native legality contract.
- Find a finite common-lattice certificate for a two-generator block algebra without complete rank-one anchors. Individual integral characteristic polynomials do not guarantee a common lattice.

## Related open work

- PR6446 studies common integer lattices for separately rounded planar shears. This result concerns exact rational group labels and paired 2-adic lattices; it uses no result from that PR and computes no competing rounding quantity.
- No other open PR found in the bounded live search studies this monogenic paired-lattice criterion. The complete cached open-PR search covered 734 records and 6,837 Discussion records; sparse local notes remain incomplete. New account PRs published after the claim were inspected by title and scope, without extra mathematical replays.
